ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which animal shown in the diagram is an herbivore?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image is a food web, labeled with animals Cheetah, Coyote, Rattlesnake, Jackrabbit, Cottontail, Chuckwalla, and plants Mojave Yucca, Cactus, Shrub. The arrows indicate from the food source to the consumer; in the image, it can be seen that arrows from plant sources point to Cottontail. The question asks which animal is a herbivore. herbivore refers to an animal that eats plants, so an animal receiving arrows from plants meets the condition. Cottontail is shown as eating plants, so the answer is cottontail.
